Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy — StoryPlay

StoryPlay respects your privacy. This policy explains in clear words what information is used and why.

What information is used

Your name and email are used only for login and account identification. This information is never sold to any third party.

Your activity

Your watch history, the choices you make inside a story and your coin balance are linked only to your account — so the story continues from where you left it, and your unlocks stay safe.

Your control

From Settings, you can clear your watch history or delete your account at any time. Deleting your account removes all data on this device.

Changes

If this policy changes, the new version will appear right here on this screen.

Terms of Use

Terms of Use — StoryPlay

By using StoryPlay, you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.

Stories and choices

StoryPlay's stories are interactive fiction. Every decision is yours, and the endings are shaped by your choices — one story can have many different endings.

Coins

Coins are only for unlocking episodes inside the app. They have no cash value and cannot be transferred to anyone else.

Who publishes content

Stories and videos are published only by the Owner. Users cannot upload content inside the app.

Premium

Premium plan benefits — ad-free viewing, unlimited viewing and download access — are available while the plan is active.

Account

You are responsible for keeping your account information correct. Deleting your account removes this device's data forever.

0%

Tapping Update Now downloads the new version right here inside the app, with progress on screen — you are never sent to a browser or the Downloads folder. The moment the download finishes, the Android installer opens inside the app itself — tap Install once and the new app installs over the old one, no uninstall is needed, and your login, coins and progress stay completely safe.

🌿 Branching Story Builder

Upload multiple video clips as named Nodes — e.g. Scene 1 - Intro, Scene 2A - Run Away, Scene 2B - Fight. For each node set the decision trigger time (when choices appear), write 2 to 3 choice button texts, and pick which uploaded node each button links to from the dropdown. This builds the Stories → VideoNodes → Choices tree — no linear episode order.
